newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: One, three-month Saudi t-bill rates fall, six flat.
newsitem.headline: One, three-month Saudi t-bill rates fall, six flat.

text.p: Yields were steady to easier at this week's offering of Saudi treasury bills worth three billion riyals to local banks by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency, a banker said on Monday.

The yield on 28-day bills fell to 5.2952 percent from 5.3332 percent, while the rate on 91-day paper fell to 5.4360 from 5.4598 percent a week earlier. The 190-day bills were steady at 5.5444 percent.
One-month interbank rates were put at 5-7/16, 5/16 percent, three months were at 5-9/16, 7/16 percent and six months were at 5-11/16, 9/16 percent.
